facts.fact: Hailstorm is a localized calamity covered at individual farm level for an insured farmer
facts.quote: 1.4. LOCALISED CALAMITIES (individual farm basis): Loss / damage resulting from occurrence of identified localized risks i.e. hailstorm, landslide, and Inundation affecting isolated farms in the notified area.

facts.fact: The farmer must report the loss within 72 hours of the event
facts.quote: Intimation may be given within 72 hours by the farmer either directly through the "Crop Insurance App" or dedicated toll-free number, Centralized Call Centre number of concerned Insurance Company.

facts.fact: The first-choice channels are the Crop Insurance App and the centralised toll-free number
facts.quote: The ﬁrst mode of intimation should be the "Crop Insurance App" and the centralised Toll-Free Number for this purpose.

facts.fact: The centralised toll-free number for reporting crop loss is the Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH) 14447
facts.quote: Raise Queries, tell us about your Grievances & Report loss of Crop. Call us at 14447 Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH)

facts.fact: The loss can also be reported through the bank branch, the local agriculture department or district officials
facts.quote: The intimation may also be forwarded through the concerned bank branch, local agriculture department Government/district ofﬁcials or through the toll free number.

facts.fact: When reported through the bank or officials, the insurance company must be informed within 48 hours
facts.quote: In case the intimation has been through the concerned bank branch or Government ofﬁcials, the concerned IC should be informed within the next 48 hours.

facts.fact: The intimation should give the farmer's name, affected survey number, crop and area, NCIP application number and mobile number
facts.quote: Intimation must contain details of insured farmer's name, affected survey number-wise insured crop and acreage affected, Farmer's Application No as on NCIP, his/her Mobile Number etc.

facts.fact: It should also give the KCC account number (loanee) or savings bank account (non-loanee)
facts.quote: KCC A/c No. (in case of loanee farmer) or Saving bank Account (in case of Non-Loanee farmer as declared at the time of applying for crop insurance)

facts.fact: The PMFBY WhatsApp chatbot 7065514447 is shown on the portal
facts.quote: WhatsApp ChatBot - 7065514447 | Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH) - 14447

facts.fact: Post-harvest losses from hailstorm to crops kept in 'cut and spread' condition for up to 14 days are covered
facts.quote: occurrence of hailstorm, cyclone, cyclonic rains and unseasonal rains resulting in damage to harvested crop lying in the ﬁeld in 'cut and spread'/small bundled condition depending on nature of the crop in that area kept solely to dry upto a maximum period of two weeks (14 days)

facts.fact: Post-harvest losses are also reported within 72 hours
facts.quote: Immediate intimation (within 72 hours) by the insured farmer to Insurance Company through "Crop Insurance App" or any available channel of reporting

summary: All facts confirmed: 72-hour intimation, channels, 48-hour forwarding, required details and post-harvest 14-day cover (OG 2020 on pmfby.gov.in), hailstorm localized cover (FAQ), KRPH 14447 and WhatsApp 7065514447 (pmfby.gov.in home).
